ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black contiguous region across the central and medial areas of both lobes; high-intensity white regions localized at the distal lateral tips featuring sparse, low-intensity dark circular mottling and irregular spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations along the continuous boundary of both visible lobe trailing edges; right lobe (viewer perspective) shows deeper, more defined indentations than the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the visible trailing edge transitioning into a sharp upward/outward hook at the extreme lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, three-dimensional textured pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct light-colored linear pixel disruptions visible on the dark pigmentation of the right lobe, and dark linear scratches cutting through the white pigmentation on the left lobe tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal tips of both lobes creating irregular, protruding topographic profiles localized to the lateral edges.
